title: 第36章 继续排查
content_zh:
第36章 继续排查-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

上一章

存书签

下一章

临时指挥室的白板上多了两张照片——朴正勋，保洁身份掩护的外围情报员；另一个是从后厨揪出来的投毒人员。

A方案暗杀，失败。

B方案货车截杀，失败。

两颗暗子拔除，但顾承安没有任何放松的意思。

他盯着白板上用红笔标注的时间轴，沉默了一会，开口：“改变一下方案。”

正准备继续铺开排查的陆鸣愣了一下。

“我们的人分两班轮换休息，监控室保持双人值守，外围暗哨不撤，东西两侧消防通道各留一个人，其余的全去睡觉。”

魏国平从门口探进半个身子：“不继续排了？”

“现在大楼里没几个人，就算逐层过一遍也排不出什么。”顾承安说，“对方的布局不是人海战术，是精准投放。深更半夜把自己人跑废了，天亮以后参会人员涌进来的时候反而没精力盯，本末倒置。”

魏国平想了想，点头：“行，我去安排。”

顾承安补充了一句：“让弟兄们睡之前把手台充上电，明早六点半全员集合，有硬仗要打。”

魏国平应声走了。

陆鸣有点不太理解，但没多问。

他虽然跟顾承安共事时间比较短，可有一条经验已经刻进脑子——这位007同志做的每一个决定，事后回头看，全是对的。

“你也去眯一会儿。”顾承安看了他一眼。

“你呢？”

“我再看看东西。”

陆鸣没再坚持，转身出了指挥室。

房间安静下来。

顾承安把椅子拉到白板前，坐下来，两手交叉撑着下巴，盯着那张会议中心的平面图。

他在想一个问题。

日方的布局模式是多线切割、各组互不知情、单线暗网联络。这套路本质上是牺牲效率换容错率——任何一条线被端掉，不影响其他线的执行。

A方案和B方案已经废了，但这种布局方式意味着，95%以上概率还有C、D甚至E。

There are two more photos on the whiteboard in the temporary command room - Park Zhengxun, the peripheral intelligence agent who kept his identity hidden; the other is the poisoner who was found out from the kitchen.

Plan A, assassination, failed.

Plan B failed with the truck interception.

Two hidden gems were removed, but Gu Chengan had no intention of relaxing.

He stared at the timeline marked with red pen on the whiteboard, was silent for a while, and then said, "Change the plan."

Lu Ming, who was about to continue the investigation, was stunned for a moment.

"Our people take turns to rest in two shifts. Two people are on duty in the control room. Secret sentries on the outside are not removed. One person is left on each fire exit on the east and west sides, and the rest go to sleep."

Wei Guoping leaned halfway in from the door: "Aren't you going to continue queuing?"

"There are not many people in the building now, and even if we go through it floor by floor, we can't find anything." Gu Cheng'an said, "The other party's layout is not a crowd tactic, but a precise placement. We will lose our own people in the middle of the night. When the participants pour in after dawn, we will not have the energy to keep an eye on them, putting the cart before the horse."

Wei Guoping thought for a while and nodded: "Okay, I'll make arrangements."

Gu Chengan added: "Let the brothers charge their desks before going to bed. Everyone will gather at 6:30 tomorrow morning. There is a tough battle to be fought."

Wei Guoping responded and left.

Lu Ming didn't quite understand, but he didn't ask any more questions.

Although he had only worked with Gu Chengan for a relatively short time, one piece of experience had already been engraved in his mind - every decision made by Comrade 007, looking back afterwards, was the right one.

"Go and squint for a while." Gu Chengan glanced at him.

"What about you?"

"I'll look at things again."

Lu Ming didn't insist anymore and turned around and left the command room.

The room fell silent.

Gu Chengan pulled the chair in front of the whiteboard, sat down, crossed his hands and supported his chin, staring at the floor plan of the conference center.

He was thinking about a question.

Japan’s layout model is multi-line cutting, each group is unaware of each other, and a single line of dark network communication.This approach essentially sacrifices efficiency for fault tolerance - if any line is terminated, it will not affect the execution of other lines.

Plans A and B have been abandoned, but this layout method means that there is more than 95% probability of C, D or even E.
